about.blurb: Rafeeq Al-Darb is a comprehensive Islamic app built on trusted sources that are freely available to developers. Every mushaf, translation and adhan recording was checked against its source before it shipped, and every source is named so you can verify it yourself.
about.f_quran_desc: A full text mushaf plus six printed editions: coloured Tajweed, Shamarly, illuminated Madinah, Indo-Pak colour-coded, Warsh and Qalun.
about.f_translations_desc: An established translation per language, all 6,236 verses complete, alongside tafsir, i’rab and word meanings.
about.f_audio_desc: Continuous recitation with verse highlighting and auto-scroll, and ten muezzins with attributed names.
about.f_prayer_desc: Four calculation methods, manual correction of times and the Hijri date, and a qibla compass.
about.f_hadith_desc: Over forty thousand hadiths by chapter, plus a searchable text book library.
about.f_azkar_desc: Day and night adhkar as cards, a digital tasbeeh, and khatma tracking.
about.f_offline_desc: Quran, adhkar and prayer times work with no connection, and anything downloaded stays on your device.
about.sources_intro: Every piece of content in the app comes from the sources below. Tap any one to open its site and check for yourself.
